narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One and one on top, four and three below, so it makes two sevenths.
<bookmark mark='seven'/>Two sevenths is smaller than one third of the glass all alone.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Adding curd to the water cannot leave less in the glass than the water alone.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>First make the units the same, then add the numerators and keep the unit.
<bookmark mark='name'/>This way of adding, after the great mathematician Brahmagupta, is called Brahmagupta's method.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. What do one fifth and one half of a glass make together?
